findings.current: He had spent the past two weeks using every means available to investigate everything about Jin Taekyung.
findings.explanation: The Korean identifies Butler Kim as the person who investigated Jin Taekyung; the English pronoun follows a sentence naming Choi Minwoo.
findings.korean: 김 집사가 그렇다면 그런 거다. 그는 지난 2주 동안 온갖 수단을 동원해 진태경의 모든 걸 들여다본 사람이니까.
findings.replacement: Butler Kim had spent the past two weeks using every means available to investigate everything about Jin Taekyung.

summary: One pronoun attributes Butler Kim’s investigation to Choi Minwoo.
